title: Viva Insights: admins choose which organisational attributes appear as filters in Copilot Power BI reports
summary: The briefing passes: the admin route, additional-filter default, licensing inclusion and privacy protections are supported. It should acknowledge Microsoft's conflicting licensing thresholds and cite the additional documentation supporting tenant scope and data-quality risks.

claims.claim: The roadmap lists the feature as Launched.
claims.quote: "status": "Launched", "statusKey": "launched"

claims.claim: The release phase is General Availability.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.claim: The roadmap target is June CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "June CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap gives no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope

claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified at 2026-06-26T22:01:51.
The roadmap says Global and Insights admins can enable additional Power BI report filters.
claims.quote: Enable Global and Insights admins to turn on additional attributes as filters in Power BI reports

claims.claim: The additional filters include reserved attributes.
claims.quote: including reserved attributes and your organization’s custom attributes

claims.claim: The additional filters include the organization's custom attributes.
claims.quote: including reserved attributes and your organization’s custom attributes

claims.where: title; What's changing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Users with access to the Power BI reports can use newly enabled filters to tailor those reports.
claims.quote: Users who have access to Power BI reports can then use these newly enabled filters to tailor reports to their business needs.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: A Viva Insights Administrator manages the attribute-filter setting.
claims.quote: As a Viva Insights Administrator, you can configure some of the filters analysts can use when they create or access reports using advanced analysis.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The route is Viva Insights web app > Analysis setup > Attribute filters > Data field quality > Enable filter.
claims.quote: In the Viva Insights web app, under Analysis setup on the left, select Attribute filters. Under Data field quality, select Enable filter for the filtered attributes you'd like analysts to access in their reports.

claims.claim: No API, Microsoft Graph or PowerShell equivalent for enabling individual attribute filters is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights attribute filters Enable filter PowerShell Microsoft Graph API configure; "Viva Insights" "attribute filters" "Graph" "beta"; "Viva Insights" "attribute filters" "PowerShell". Read enable-filters-for-reports and manage-access-policies excerpts; no equivalent found.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Additional attribute filters are admin-opt-in and appear after an administrator enables them.
claims.quote: Once enabled, these filters can be found under Filter by in prebuilt reports in the Reports tab. Under Data field quality, select Enable filter for the filtered attributes you'd like analysts to access in their reports.

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Why it matters; Scope
claims.claim: Organization, CountryOrRegion and FunctionType are enabled by default.
claims.quote: Organization, CountryOrRegion, and FunctionType are enabled by default for Power BI reports.

claims.claim: Organization is a mandatory filter in prebuilt Power BI reports and cannot be turned off.
claims.quote: Organization is a mandatory filter in prebuilt Power BI reports that you can't turn off.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Enabled filters appear under Filter by in prebuilt reports in the Reports tab.
claims.quote: Once enabled, these filters can be found under Filter by in prebuilt reports in the Reports tab.

claims.claim: The filter attributes come from the organization's Viva Insights organizational data.
claims.quote: There are three types of attributes you can add in your organizational data file: required, reserved optional, and custom.

claims.claim: LevelDesignation, FunctionType and Location are reserved attribute column names.
claims.quote: Reserved optional ... LevelDesignation ... FunctionType ... Location ... the names of these required and reserved attributes can't be used as the names of any new custom attributes.

claims.claim: Reserved attributes are used to calculate, filter and group data.
claims.quote: The following attributes are reserved column headers for attributes that are currently used to calculate, filter, and group data.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Custom attributes are attributes the organization defines and adds to its data upload.
claims.quote: Custom attributes are any other attributes you want to define to use in filtering and grouping data. When you upload these attributes, analysts can use them when building queries.

claims.claim: Copilot Analytics reports provide adoption and impact insights.
claims.quote: These reports provide a variety of targeted insights about the adoption and impact of Microsoft Copilot across your organization.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: The Copilot Analytics reports page still says out-of-the-box reports cannot be customized with unique filters or attributes, unlike the filters page.
claims.quote: Unlike custom Power BI queries, these reports can't be customized with unique filters or attributes.

claims.claim: Missing or sparsely populated attributes reduce the quality of filtered insights.
claims.quote: If a column has too many blank rows, that attribute has low coverage. Attributes with less than 30% coverage are considered low-quality. Similar to missing insights, when data is of low quality, related insights are of low quality, too.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/analyst/data-quality-analyst-experience to sources and cite it for the data-quality statement in Why it matters.

claims.claim: Microsoft names ManagerId and PersonId among attributes available for filters.
claims.quote: These filters are available for several different organizational attributes in Viva Insights, such as FunctionType, Organization, ManagerId, and PersonId.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Why it matters
claims.claim: Organizational filters let users narrow views to smaller populations.
claims.quote: Use report filters to focus on an organizational population already within your authorized scope. ... Filters narrow data

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Viva Insights minimum group size applies to data visualizations in advanced analysis Power BI templates.
claims.quote: The minimum group size applies to data visualizations in advanced analysis Power BI templates as well as group comparisons in organization insights for leaders and managers in Outlook and Teams.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The minimum group size must be at least five.
claims.quote: You'll need to set this number to at least five.

claims.claim: Results can be blank or suppressed when a report filter produces a group below its applicable privacy threshold.
claims.quote: Results can be blank or suppressed when a filter produces a group below the applicable privacy threshold.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Available attributes depend on the report and organizational data configured.
claims.quote: Available attributes depend on the report and on the organizational data configured by your organization.

claims.claim: Filters do not grant access outside a user's role, delegation or analyst partition.
claims.quote: Filters narrow data; they don't grant access to people or groups outside your role, delegation, or analyst partition.

claims.claim: A Microsoft 365 Global Administrator assigns Insights Administrator and Insights Analyst roles.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Global Administrator: Assigns the Insights Analyst and Insights Administrator roles.

claims.claim: Attribute filtering is included within the licensed Viva Insights advanced analysis product.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot plans also include manager, leader, and advanced analysis for all employees who have an assigned Copilot license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot plans include manager, leader and advanced analysis for employees assigned Copilot licenses.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot plans also include manager, leader, and advanced analysis for all employees who have an assigned Copilot license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The environment requirements page states that at least 50 assigned Viva Insights licenses are needed for advanced analysis and the Copilot Dashboard.
claims.quote: At least 50 assigned Viva Insights licenses are required to access advanced analysis and the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard.
claims.fix: Keep the attributed 50-license statement and add: 'Microsoft's service description gives a different threshold: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard and Advanced Copilot Reporting in Viva Insights comes with Microsoft 365 Copilot or 10 Insights licenses.' Cite and add https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/microsoft-viva-service-description#feature-availability to sources.

claims.claim: The 50-license threshold can combine Copilot licenses including the Viva Insights service plan with Viva Insights licenses.
claims.quote: This minimum threshold can be achieved through a combination of licenses. For example, 30 assigned Microsoft Copilot licenses (which include the Viva Insights service plan) + 20 assigned Viva Insights licenses = 50 assigned Viva Insights licenses.

claims.claim: No license specific to attribute filters is published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Insights" "attribute filters" license pricing billing. Opened enable-filters-for-reports and environment-requirements; read assign-licenses and Microsoft Viva service-description excerpts. No filter-specific license found.

claims.claim: Microsoft publishes no meter or separate charge specific to attribute filters at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Power BI organizational attribute filters licensing price meter separate charge. Opened enable-filters-for-reports and environment-requirements, including Pricing; read licensing excerpts. No filter-specific charge found.

claims.claim: The administrator's attribute-filter setting has tenant scope.
claims.quote: What you set as an admin (unless you’re setting up a partition) applies across your organization.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/admin/partitions to sources as support for the tenant scope.

claims.claim: The Viva Insights privacy settings page applies to Insights Administrators.
claims.quote: Applies to: Insights Administrator

controlChecks.governs: Which organisational attributes report users can filter by in Viva Insights Power BI reports
